title: UnMaskFork: Test-Time Scaling for Masked Diffusion via Deterministic Action Branching

layout.note: One top-down tree: root at the top centre, two children, then grandchildren and a bottom row of four completed strips with scores; a framed key sits in the top-right corner and the title above the root.

lesson: Draw a search over generation states as a top-down tree of identical token strips, colour each branch and each newly unmasked cell by the model that acted, and mark cached or rolled-out nodes with dashed outlines explained in a small framed key.
